howto.name: Upload an archive
howto.text: Drop a .zip, .tar, .tar.gz, .tar.bz2, or .tar.xz archive up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools extracts and returns each file
howto.text: All files inside are extracted and bundled into a folder-style download.

howto.name: Download the extracted folder as a ZIP
howto.text: Or download individual files from the result preview.

faq.a: Password-protected archives are not supported yet. Extract Archive currently handles unencrypted ZIP and TAR-family archives; encrypted archive support is on the roadmap.
No. Extract Archive currently supports ZIP and TAR-family archives (.tar, .tar.gz, .tar.bz2, .tar.xz). RAR and 7z support is on the roadmap.

faq.q: What if the archive contains many small files?
faq.a: Up to 1000 files per archive. For larger, split before zipping.
